paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 处生成内部理由以解释未来文本，从而改进预测 [abstract][S1.p2]。方法上采用 tokenwise 并行采样、可学习的思考起止 token 以及扩展的 teacher-forcing 技术 [abstract]。在 Mistral 7B 上使用 OpenWebMath 和 C4 进行继续预训练后，模型在 GSM8K 上零样本从 5.9% 提升到 10.9%，在 CommonsenseQA 上从 36.3% 提升到 47.2%，且这些改进无需针对任务微调 [abstract][S1.p3]。作者认为 Quiet-STaR 是迈向更通用、可扩展推理的一步 [abstract][S7.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：STaR 等方法依赖人工整理的问答数据集来学习推理，这限制了理由的规模和泛化性，因为高质量问答数据集只能覆盖推理任务的一个子集 [S1.p2]。因此作者希望让语言模型从大规模互联网文本中学习生成有助于推断未来文本的推理，从而利用语言中存在的多样任务 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.
QA datasets, especially high-quality ones, require thoughtful curation and will inherently only ever cover a subset of reasoning tasks.
we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus.

method.text: Quiet-STaR 在每一个 token 之后生成理由来解释未来文本（think），将带理由和不带理由的未来文本预测进行混合（talk），再用 REINFORCE 学习生成更好的理由（learn）[S1.F1][S1.p3]。为应对生成续写的计算成本、模型初始不知道如何生成或使用内部思考、以及需要预测超出单个下一 token 等挑战，作者提出 tokenwise 并行采样算法、指示思考开始与结束的可学习 token，以及扩展的 teacher-forcing 技术 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: We generate thoughts, in parallel, following all tokens in the text (think).
The model produces a mixture of its next-token predictions with and without a thought (talk).
We apply REINFORCE, as in STaR, to increase the likelihood of thoughts that help the model predict future text
we propose a tokenwise parallel sampling algorithm, using learnable tokens indicating a thought’s start and end, and an extended teacher-forcing technique.

experiments.text: 作者将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 Mistral 7B，使用网络文本数据集 OpenWebMath 和 Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus (C4) 进行继续预训练 [S1.p3]。实验评估模型在 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 上的零样本直接推理能力，并考察思考 token 数量对性能的影响 [S5.p1][S5.SS1.p1]。此外还研究了在零样本思维链提示下使用内部理由的效果，在 128 个 GSM8K 测试样本上以温度 0.7 采样 8 条链并取多数投票 [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We apply Quiet-STaR to Mistral 7B using the web text datasets OpenWebMath and Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus (C4,).
We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
we evaluate the extent to which Quiet-STaR improves the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of the language model on CommonsenseQA and GSM8K.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR, as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items.
Note that each chain-of-thought solution is sampled with temperature 0.7.

findings.text: 在无需针对任务微调的情况下，Quiet-STaR 提升了零样本直接推理能力：CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 提升到 47.2%，GSM8K 从 5.9% 提升到 10.9% [abstract][S1.p3]。在 CommonsenseQA 上相比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且性能随模型理由中使用的 token 数量增加而持续提升 [S5.SS1.p1]。在零样本思维链设置下，8 样本多数投票准确率从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。作者还观察到生成的内部理由使模型能生成更结构化、连贯的思维链 [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: we find zero-shot improvements on GSM8K (5.9% → 10.9%) and CommonsenseQA (36.3% → 47.2%)
Quiet-STaR results in improvements to zero-shot direct-reasoning abilities on CommonsenseQA (36.3% $\rightarrow$ 47.2%) and GSM8K (5.9% $\rightarrow$ 10.9%)
On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
this improvement consistently increases with the number of tokens used in the model’s rationales
on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR
internal rationales allow the model to generate more structured and coherent chains of thought

limitations.text: 作者指出，为解决各种元学习挑战而做了一些简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术从零开始训练模型时是否有效，且只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 会带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前都要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由，作者认为这是一个自然的扩展方向 [S6.p2]。此外，无法确知模型用语言表达的推理是否准确反映其内部处理（忠实性），且若模型发现有害或有偏的推理模式有用，也没有防护措施 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch.
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness).
there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
